title: Evidence_quote stored full-text but _finding_public truncates to 2000/1000 chars for prompts, risking mid-word cuts and loss of critical context

finding.claim: Evidence_quote stored full-text but _finding_public truncates to 2000/1000 chars for prompts, risking mid-word cuts and loss of critical context
finding.recommendation: Ensure evidence_quote is stored and transmitted whole-text; the truncation in _finding_public should only be for display and must not alter the stored record's evidence. Verify that full-text is always persisted to sidecars.

code_region.text:
def _finding_public(finding):
    """The finding fields a confirmation/re-ground prompt may see.
    Evidence is stored full-text in the record (sidecars, §4 Q7);
    what a PROMPT shows is display, so it is sliced here — the
    stored text is never cut by prompt construction."""
    shown = {k: finding.get(k) for k in
             ("id", "severity", "category", "file", "line", "title",
              "evidence", "evidence_quote", "recommendation")}
    shown["evidence"] = str(shown.get("evidence") or "")[:2000]
    shown["evidence_quote"] = str(
        shown.get("evidence_quote") or "")[:1000]
    return json.dumps(shown, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)


def _reground_call(fn, finding, region):
    """One re-ground attempt. Returns (outcome, quote, reason) with
    outcome in confirmed|withdrawn|unresolved. A confirmed outcome
    counts only when the returned quote validates against the
    region text — the same deterministic bar as the first pass."""
    prompt = _REGROUND_PROMPT.format(
        finding=_finding_public(finding), region=region[:20000])

refutation.quote: Evidence is stored full-text in the record (sidecars, §4 Q7);
refutation.reason: The cited truncation is explicitly limited to prompt/display construction in _finding_public, while the code comments state storage remains full-text in the record sidecars. The claim that stored evidence is altered by this truncation is not supported by this region.

probe.summary: Finding-public probe (`probes/finding_public_probe.py`, result `finding-public-4ce0212286e0.txt`): the solution's expected probe outcome — adjudication prompts never call `_finding_public` — is FALSE at HEAD. All three adjudication prompt types (re-ground, cross-family confirmation, Tech Lead) route the finding through it; pre-hardening, a 3004-char evidence text reached the adjudicator sliced at exactly 2000 chars, mid-word, with no marker. Storage half verified separately: sidecars hold full text and the store path never passes through `_finding_public`. HARDENING LANDED (commit c1bf1df): `_prompt_slice` cuts at a word boundary and appends '…[truncated, N chars, sha256:…]'; post-hardening probe run shows the marker in all three prompt types; parent-fail verified (`hardening-parent-fail.txt`). Context beyond this item's scope: the Tech Lead prompt also caps dispute positions inline (400/300/400 chars).
